```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(jsonlite)

base_dir <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM/figure_numbers_new/fig3_external_zeroshot"
metrics_csv <- file.path(base_dir, "fig23_all_metrics.csv")
json_file <- file.path(base_dir, "fig23_numbers_our3_ecgfm1.json")
out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "af_hf_pdf")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

non_rs_models <- c(
  "ECG-FM",
  "ECGFounder",
  "DeepECG-SSL",
  "DeepECG-SL",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI)"
)

plus_rs_models <- c(
  "ECG-FM +RS",
  "ECGFounder +RS",
  "DeepECG-SSL +RS",
  "DeepECG-SL +RS",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) +RS",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) +RS"
)

fig_json <- fromJSON(json_file, simplifyVector = FALSE)

parse_fig23_json_metrics <- function(fig_json) {
  rows <- list()

  for (key in names(fig_json)) {
    if (startsWith(key, "_")) next

    key_parts <- str_split_fixed(key, "\\|", 2)
    dataset_i <- key_parts[, 1]
    label_i <- key_parts[, 2]
    entry <- fig_json[[key]]
    models_i <- unique(c(
      names(entry$auroc$bars %||% list()),
      names(entry$auprc$bars %||% list())
    ))

    for (model_i in models_i) {
      auroc_i <- entry$auroc$bars[[model_i]]
      auprc_i <- entry$auprc$bars[[model_i]]

      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        dataset = dataset_i,
        label = label_i,
        model = model_i,
        n = entry$n,
        pos = entry$pos,
        neg = entry$neg,
        auroc = auroc_i$point %||% NA_real_,
        auroc_ci_lo = auroc_i$ci_lo %||% NA_real_,
        auroc_ci_hi = auroc_i$ci_hi %||% NA_real_,
        auprc = auprc_i$point %||% NA_real_,
        auprc_ci_lo = auprc_i$ci_lo %||% NA_real_,
        auprc_ci_hi = auprc_i$ci_hi %||% NA_real_
      )
    }
  }

  bind_rows(rows)
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

plot_models <- unique(c(non_rs_models, plus_rs_models))

metrics <- if (file.exists(metrics_csv)) {
  read_csv(metrics_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  parse_fig23_json_metrics(fig_json) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
    write_csv(metrics_csv)
  read_csv(metrics_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

metrics <- metrics %>%
  filter(model %in% plot_models) %>%
  mutate(
    label_display = recode(label, af5 = "Atrial Fibrillation", hf5 = "Heart Failure"),
    panel_label = paste(dataset, label_display, sep = " - ")
  )

symbol_map <- c(
  "ECG-FM" = "*",
  "ECGFounder" = "\u2020",
  "DeepECG-SSL" = "\u2021",
  "DeepECG-SL" = "\u00A7"
)

base_model_name <- function(x) {
  str_remove(x, " \\+RS$")
}

extract_sig_table <- function(fig_json) {
  rows <- list()

  for (key in names(fig_json)) {
    if (startsWith(key, "_")) next

    key_parts <- str_split_fixed(key, "\\|", 2)
    dataset_i <- key_parts[, 1]
    label_i <- key_parts[, 2]

    for (metric_i in c("auroc", "auprc")) {
      pairs <- fig_json[[key]][[metric_i]][["pairs"]]
      if (is.null(pairs) || length(pairs) == 0) next

      for (pair in pairs) {
        if (!isTRUE(pair$sig)) next

        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
          dataset = dataset_i,
          label = label_i,
          model = pair$bar,
          metric = metric_i,
          vs = pair$vs,
          symbol = unname(symbol_map[[base_model_name(pair$vs)]])
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(rows) %>%
    filter(!is.na(symbol)) %>%
    mutate(
      symbol_order = match(symbol, unname(symbol_map))
    ) %>%
    arrange(dataset, label, model, metric, symbol_order) %>%
    group_by(dataset, label, model, metric) %>%
    summarise(
      sig = paste0(symbol, collapse = ""),
      sig_vs = paste(vs, collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = metric,
      values_from = c(sig, sig_vs),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{metric}",
      values_fill = ""
    )
}

sig_table <- extract_sig_table(fig_json)

metrics_with_sig <- metrics %>%
  left_join(sig_table, by = c("dataset", "label", "model")) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_auroc = coalesce(sig_auroc, ""),
    sig_auprc = coalesce(sig_auprc, ""),
    sig_vs_auroc = coalesce(sig_vs_auroc, ""),
    sig_vs_auprc = coalesce(sig_vs_auprc, "")
  )

write_csv(metrics_with_sig, file.path(base_dir, "fig23_all_metrics_with_significance.csv"))
```

```{r}
model_colors <- c(
  "Risk Score" = "#B8A64B",
  "ECG-FM" = "#7A869A",
  "ECGFounder" = "#0072B2",
  "DeepECG-SSL" = "#D55E00",
  "DeepECG-SL" = "#CC79A7",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)" = "#009E73",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI)" = "#56B4E9",
  "ECG-FM +RS" = "#7A869A",
  "ECGFounder +RS" = "#0072B2",
  "DeepECG-SSL +RS" = "#D55E00",
  "DeepECG-SL +RS" = "#CC79A7",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG) +RS" = "#009E73",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG+MRI) +RS" = "#56B4E9"
)

caption_non_rs <- paste0(
  "Marks on CARDIAC-FM bars = baselines they significantly beat ",
  "(paired bootstrap p<0.05): * ECG-FM   \u2020 ECGFounder   ",
  "\u2021 DeepECG-SSL   \u00A7 DeepECG-SL"
)

caption_plus_rs <- paste0(
  "Marks on CARDIAC-FM +RS bars = baselines they significantly beat ",
  "(paired bootstrap p<0.05): * ECG-FM +RS   \u2020 ECGFounder +RS   ",
  "\u2021 DeepECG-SSL +RS   \u00A7 DeepECG-SL +RS"
)

plot_one_panel <- function(df, dataset_i, label_i, metric_i, model_set, set_name) {
  metric_col <- metric_i
  lo_col <- paste0(metric_i, "_ci_lo")
  hi_col <- paste0(metric_i, "_ci_hi")
  sig_col <- paste0("sig_", metric_i)

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_i, label == label_i, model %in% model_set) %>%
    mutate(
      model = factor(model, levels = model_set),
      value = .data[[metric_col]],
      ci_lo = .data[[lo_col]],
      ci_hi = .data[[hi_col]],
      sig_label = ifelse(str_detect(as.character(model), "^CARDIAC-FM"), .data[[sig_col]], "")
    ) %>%
    arrange(model)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  present_models <- model_set[model_set %in% as.character(plot_df$model)]
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(model = factor(as.character(model), levels = present_models)) %>%
    arrange(model)

  y_min <- min(plot_df$ci_lo, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(plot_df$ci_hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pad <- max(0.025, (y_max - y_min) * 0.18)
  y_lower <- max(0, floor((y_min - y_pad) * 20) / 20)
  y_upper <- min(1, ceiling((y_max + y_pad) * 20) / 20)

  caption_text <- if (set_name == "plus_rs") caption_plus_rs else caption_non_rs
  metric_label <- toupper(metric_i)
  outcome_label <- recode(label_i, af5 = "Atrial Fibrillation", hf5 = "Heart Failure")

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = model, y = value, fill = model)) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.72,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
      width = 0.14,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      color = "#333333",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = ci_hi + y_pad * 0.22, label = sig_label),
      size = 7,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",
      vjust = 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = model_colors[present_models],
      breaks = present_models,
      limits = present_models
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.05),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lower, y_upper)) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = metric_label,
      fill = NULL,
      title = paste(dataset_i, outcome_label, metric_label),
      caption = str_wrap(caption_text, width = 95)
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(b = 2),

      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "black", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black", face = "bold", angle = 35, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black", face = "bold", lineheight = 0.95),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#E2E6EC", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 12,
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(t = 14),
        face = "bold",
        lineheight = 1.05
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 18, 24, 38)
    )
}

plot_dataset_panel <- function(df, dataset_i, metric_i, model_set, set_name) {
  metric_col <- metric_i
  lo_col <- paste0(metric_i, "_ci_lo")
  hi_col <- paste0(metric_i, "_ci_hi")
  sig_col <- paste0("sig_", metric_i)

  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_i, model %in% model_set) %>%
    mutate(
      label_display = factor(
        recode(label, af5 = "Atrial Fibrillation", hf5 = "Heart Failure"),
        levels = c("Atrial Fibrillation", "Heart Failure")
      ),
      model = factor(model, levels = model_set),
      value = .data[[metric_col]],
      ci_lo = .data[[lo_col]],
      ci_hi = .data[[hi_col]],
      sig_label = ifelse(str_detect(as.character(model), "^CARDIAC-FM"), .data[[sig_col]], "")
    ) %>%
    arrange(label_display, model)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  present_models <- model_set[model_set %in% as.character(plot_df$model)]
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(model = factor(as.character(model), levels = present_models)) %>%
    arrange(label_display, model)

  y_min <- min(plot_df$ci_lo, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(plot_df$ci_hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pad <- max(0.025, (y_max - y_min) * 0.18)
  y_lower <- max(0, floor((y_min - y_pad) * 20) / 20)
  y_upper <- min(1, ceiling((y_max + y_pad) * 20) / 20)

  caption_text <- if (set_name == "plus_rs") caption_plus_rs else caption_non_rs
  metric_label <- toupper(metric_i)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = label_display, y = value, fill = model, group = model)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.86),
      width = 0.72,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.86),
      width = 0.14,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      color = "#333333",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = ci_hi + y_pad * 0.22, label = sig_label),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.86),
      size = 7,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",
      vjust = 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = model_colors[present_models],
      breaks = present_models,
      limits = present_models
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.05),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lower, y_upper)) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = metric_label,
      fill = NULL,
      title = paste(dataset_i, metric_label),
      caption = str_wrap(caption_text, width = 95)
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(b = 2),

      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "black", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black", face = "bold", lineheight = 0.95),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#E2E6EC", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 12,
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(t = 14),
        face = "bold",
        lineheight = 1.05
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 18, 24, 38)
    )
}

save_one_panel <- function(p, dataset_i, label_i, metric_i, set_name) {
  stem <- paste(dataset_i, label_i, metric_i, set_name, sep = "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_") %>%
    str_to_lower()

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), p, width = 8.8, height = 5.4, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), p, width = 8.8, height = 5.4, dpi = 300)
}

save_dataset_panel <- function(p, dataset_i, metric_i, set_name) {
  stem <- paste(dataset_i, metric_i, set_name, "af_hf", sep = "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_") %>%
    str_to_lower()

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), p, width = 8.8, height = 5.4, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), p, width = 8.8, height = 5.4, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r}
plot_index <- metrics_with_sig %>%
  distinct(dataset) %>%
  arrange(match(dataset, c("UKB", "CHS", "MESA")))

all_plots <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(plot_index))) {
  dataset_i <- plot_index$dataset[i]

  for (metric_i in c("auroc", "auprc")) {
    for (set_name in c("non_rs", "plus_rs")) {
      model_set <- if (set_name == "plus_rs") plus_rs_models else non_rs_models
      p <- plot_dataset_panel(metrics_with_sig, dataset_i, metric_i, model_set, set_name)

      if (!is.null(p)) {
        plot_name <- paste(dataset_i, metric_i, set_name, "af_hf", sep = "_")
        all_plots[[plot_name]] <- p
        save_dataset_panel(p, dataset_i, metric_i, set_name)
      }
    }
  }
}
```
